_doc: Marks painted over in the base-colour texture of the AI-generated models (Space Apps rule: no NASA branding, flags or mission insignia; CLAUDE.md: no manufacturer graphics). Reviewed 2026-11-15 on the 1024 px textures. circles: [u, v, r] in texture fractions (u right, v down, as the image file); colors: pixels of these hues (decals) are replaced by their surroundings. Fill = mean colour of the ring around each mark.

blue_moon_mk2.note: two round emblem-like plaques with a drawing; small blue-field / red-white-stripe decals that read as a US flag

blue_ghost.note: black firefly / wing silhouettes (manufacturer-logo-like) and blue speckled discs (NASA-insignia-like)
